:::{#def-partial-sum}
#### Partial sum

Let $a_1, a_2, \ldots$ be a [sequence](sets-functions.qmd#def-sequence)
of real numbers or of [extended non-negative reals](sets-functions.qmd#def-extended-nonneg-reals).
For each $n \in \mathbb{N}$, its $n$th **partial sum**
is the [sum](algebra.qmd#def-summation) of its first $n$ terms:

$$s_n \eqdef \sumin a_i = a_1 + \cdots + a_n$$

:::
